Card Q&A.a: No, you can't.  You can't simultaneously activate multiple effects that play a card.
Card Q&A.q: There are two copies of this card in the battle area.Can I activate both of their [Main] effects and play one specified card with its cost reduced by the combined amount from both effects?

Card Q&A.a:
You can activate it and play the card, but the cost will not be reduced.
